text:
Carmen Li: Quick ping — nightly link crawler picked up 6 internal 404s on docs/getting-started/onboarding.html in staging (some examples + a CLI snippet). New hires keep hitting this page, can someone own a tiny fix?
DevDocs Bot: scan: 2026-03-23T02:10Z - 6 dead internal links detected in docs/getting-started/onboarding.html; examples: /examples/runner/stream, /cli/v0/connect; full report: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/3137774444
Omar W: I can take a look after standup. Carmen, did we recently rename example paths?
Carmen Li: yes we moved runner examples under /examples/runner/v2 and the CLI consolidated flags into `redwood connect login`. I didn't have time to update the inline permalinks.
Sophie H: heads-up: changing the CLI snippet affects support copy. If someone updates the command please add a changelog line so support gets alerted.
Omar W: plan: run a quick repo replace, update /examples/runner/stream -> /examples/runner/v2/stream and replace `redwood connect --legacy` with `redwood connect login`. local test command I used:
```bash
rg "/examples/runner/stream|cli/v0/connect|redwood connect --legacy" -n docs/ && \
sed -i 's@/examples/runner/stream@/examples/runner/v2/stream@g' docs/getting-started/onboarding.html && \
sed -i 's@/cli/v0/connect@/cli/connect@g' docs/getting-started/onboarding.html && \
sed -i 's@redwood connect --legacy@redwood connect login@g' docs/getting-started/onboarding.html
```
Carmen Li: perfect. Please include the scan link + a one-line note about the CLI flag deprecation in the PR body.
Omar W: will do. Opening PR now and tagging @Sophie for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/8128 — includes path fixes, CLI snippet update, and changelog note.
Sophie H: quick CR: one nit — please preserve the original link text for the example (`Streaming runner example`) so translations don't break. Also add a short sentence in the changelog mentioning "affects support snippets".
Omar W: fixed both in a follow-up push. CI running.
docs-oncall: FYI if CI passes we can merge low-risk fixes to get staging healthy before the next scan. Tag me when ready.
Omar W: CI green. tagging @docs-oncall. merging once you give the green.
docs-oncall: merging now, will trigger a re-scan.
DevDocs Bot: re-scan scheduled post-merge — will report results in this thread.
Carmen Li: thanks all, appreciated. I'll watch the re-scan and file a follow-up if anything else pops up.
